question.text: DCF (Discounted Cash Flow) valuation relies most on:

answer.text: Forecasted future cash flows discounted at a required rate

explanation.text: The Logic: DCF = PV of future FCFs discounted at WACC or cost of equity. Intrinsic value approach. The Trap: Market multiples are separate (relative valuation). Cross-Exam Context: XV Ch 10. Manager's Pro-Tip: Sensitivity-analyse key inputs (growth, discount rate) — DCF can shift 40%+ with small input changes.
